decisions.reason: As a less visible and less central consumer-facing item with likely lower sunk costs than the plant technologies, it is the easiest for management to abandon and redirect resources away from despite some reluctance to admit failure.

Because this modular line builds directly on the firm’s established industrial business and likely required meaningful engineering investment across several models, management is inclined to persist and treat any weak early uptake as temporary.

Presented as a flagship and given its own page, this product embodies a public strategic commitment with substantial sunk development effort, which strongly favors continuation under escalation of commitment.

As a flagship-direction product closely tied to the firm’s sustainability narrative and technology base, management is likely to keep backing it and explain any disappointing results as part of a still-maturing market.
